messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling out embed-service v2026-03-15b -> canary 10% in eu-west. Change window open until 18:30 UTC. Observability links: https://grafana.redwood/boards/embed-slo (SLO) and https://app.redwood/logs?query=embed-service (logs). Notify @eng-platform :loud_sound:
carla: ack. watching p95/p99 on the SLO board. will keep an eye on kv-cache traces, we toggled kv-cache-v2 in this release.
andre: quick heads-up — preflight smoke passed in staging. one small note: new trace sampler defaults to 0.2, could slightly increase tail latencies for rare paths.
sam: looked at the first 5m — p95 stable ~88ms, error_rate 0.03% so far. linking 5m heatmap: https://grafana.redwood/snap/5m-embed-heatmap
jess: getting intermittent 502s in eu-west at 17:42:13 and a small burst at 17:44:02 — sample from logs: ``[2026-04-12T17:44:02Z] embed-service svc=embed inst=embed-7 502 "upstream read timeout" trace_id=...``
carla: can you paste the query that pulled that?
sam: query I ran: `status:502 AND service:embed-service AND timestamp:[now-10m TO now] | count()` -> returned 23 in last 10m but all from two pods: embed-7 and embed-9.
andre: pod-level note: embed-7 and embed-9 had a recent kernel bump on the host (k8s node node-eu-3). kube shows a 20% restart flapping for embed-9 last 30m (OOMKilled) — could be unrelated but suspicious.
jess: propose we pause the rollout at 10% and run a focused smoke against embed-7 and embed-9: `curl -sS -D - https://embed.eu-west/api/v1/health?sample=heavy` across pods. If 5xx > 0.5% over 3m, rollback to v2026-03-14f.
ops_lead: +1 to pause. Carla, can you hold the canary?
carla: pausing canary now. deploy-bot: pause traffic shift confirmed, traffic stays at 10% canary.
deploy-bot: Canary pause acknowledged. Routing frozen. Fallback: previous version v2026-03-14f remains available.
sam: ran the health check against embed-7: 5xx 1.1% over 3m, embed-9: 5xx 0.9% and CPU spikes to 85% on embed-9. Detailed traces show longer KV lookup latencies during those windows.
jess: decision time — we should rollback. risk of letting it ramp to 50+% with host flaps. Recommend rollback to v2026-03-14f and then investigate kernel/host margin.
andre: agree. I'll pin the old version and kick rollback. Command: `rh deploy rollback --service=embed-service --to-version=v2026-03-14f --reason="midroll 5xx spike eu-west"`
carla: doing the pin for routing: `rh route pin --service=embed-service --version=v2026-03-14f --scope=eu-west` -> returns `OK pin applied`.
deploy-bot: Rollback started by andre. Rolling canary back to v2026-03-14f -> verifying 10% now.
ops_lead: running post-rollback smoke across eu-west: `for pod in embed-*; do curl -sS https://$pod.eu-west/api/v1/health; done`
sam: post-rollback numbers (5m): p95 85ms, 5xx 0.02% (down from ~1%). embed-9 CPU back to 40%. Looks healthy.
jess: re-open change window notes: created short incident doc for postmortem and linked release notes: https://confluence.redwood/notes/embed-midroll-2026-04-12. Assigning to infra to check node-eu-3 kernel bump.
and re: will follow up with infra on node-eu-3 and KV cache sampling. I'll re-run a controlled canary later after host patching.
carla: thanks team — closing this short hold. leaving the pin in place until infra gives green. If infra clears, we'll schedule a staggered canary with node exclusion. :thumbsup:
ops_lead: tl;dr: paused at 10% for 5xx spike from two pods -> pinned and rolled back to v2026-03-14f -> post-rollback checks healthy -> infra to investigate host/kernel.
deploy-bot: Change window still open. Marking this thread with `rollback` and `slo` tags. If anyone finds new signals, post here.
